title: Curculigoside alleviates ferroptosis in renal interstitial fibrosis by regulating the Nrf2/HO-1 signaling pathway.
authors: Liu, Tianyuan; Sui, Manshu; Yu, Chengyuan; Bao, Yushi; Xing, Li; Hou, Donghua; Xie, Rujuan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究仙茅苷通过Nrf2/HO-1通路缓解肾间质纤维化中的铁死亡，虽涉及分子对接但核心为湿实验与通路验证，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: Renal interstitial fibrosis (RIF) represents the final pathway in most progressive renal diseases. Curculigoside (CCG), derived from Curculigo Pilosa, affects oxidative stress and inflammation. However, the effects of CCG on RIF remain unclear. This study explored the nephroprotective role of CCG in regulating oxidative stress through the nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2)/heme oxygenase-1 (HO-1) pathway. METHODS: Bioinformatic analysis was employed to identify the targets of CCG, elucidate the underlying pathways, and analyze molecular docking results. C57BL/6 mouse models of unilateral ureteral obstruction (UUO) were established to validate the results. Morphologic changes were assessed by pathologic examination, and the expression of proteins associated with renal ferroptosis and fibrosis was analyzed by western blotting. Additionally, the levels of glutathione (GSH), malondialdehyde (MDA), superoxide dismutase (SOD), and iron were measured. RESULTS: In total, 3,532 differentially expressed genes (DEGs) were identified, comprising 2,290 upregulated and 1,242 downregulated genes. We retrieved 484 ferroptosis-related genes from the ferroptosis regulators (FerrDb) database, identifying 143 DEGs after intersecting with those from the Gene Expression Omnibus Series 217654 dataset (GSE217654). The key identified genes included nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide oxidase 4 (NOX4), activating transcription factor 3 (ATF3), mitogen-activated protein kinase 14 (MAPK14), tissue inhibitor metalloproteinase 1 (TIMP1), and early growth response 1 (EGR1). Gene Ontology (GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) analyses indicated that these genes were enriched in oxidative signaling pathways. The results exhibited the docking activity of CCG with related targets. CCG significantly alleviated histopathologic damage, reduced MDA and iron levels, and increased GSH and SOD levels. Protein analysis indicated that CCG alleviated fibrosis and enhanced the protein expression of antioxidants in UUO kidney tissues. CCG activated the Nrf2/HO-1 pathway and reduced UUO-induced ferroptosis. CONCLUSIONS: CCG may improve renal fibrosis and mitigate ferroptosis by activating the Nrf2/HO-1 signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 目的：肾间质纤维化（RIF）是大多数进行性肾脏疾病的最终通路。仙茅苷（CCG）源自仙茅（Curculigo Pilosa），影响氧化应激和炎症。然而，CCG对RIF的作用尚不清楚。本研究探讨了CCG通过核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）/血红素加氧酶-1（HO-1）通路调节氧化应激的肾脏保护作用。方法：采用生物信息学分析识别CCG的靶点，阐明潜在通路，并分析分子对接结果。建立C57BL/6小鼠单侧输尿管梗阻（UUO）模型以验证结果。通过病理检查评估形态学变化，并通过蛋白质印迹法分析与肾铁死亡和纤维化相关蛋白的表达。此外，测量了谷胱甘肽（GSH）、丙二醛（MDA）、超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）和铁的水平。结果：共鉴定出3,532个差异表达基因（DEGs），包括2,290个上调基因和1,242个下调基因。我们从铁死亡调节因子（FerrDb）数据库中检索到484个铁死亡相关基因，与基因表达综合系列217654数据集（GSE217654）中的基因取交集后，鉴定出143个DEGs。关键识别基因包括烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸氧化酶4（NOX4）、激活转录因子3（ATF3）、丝裂原活化蛋白激酶14（MAPK14）、组织金属蛋白酶抑制剂1（TIMP1）和早期生长反应1（EGR1）。基因本体论（GO）和京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）分析表明，这些基因富集于氧化信号通路。结果显示CCG与相关靶点具有对接活性。CCG显著减轻了组织病理学损伤，降低了MDA和铁水平，并增加了GSH和SOD水平。蛋白质分析表明，CCG减轻了纤维化并增强了UUO肾组织中抗氧化蛋白的表达。CCG激活了Nrf2/HO-1通路，并减少了UUO诱导的铁死亡。结论：CCG可能通过激活Nrf2/HO-1信号通路改善肾纤维化并减轻铁死亡。
